          Export

          Pick a format. Layers, names and colors go with the model; your program's formats come first.

          Inside Claude, CAD files are saved inside a .zip (Claude saves only common file types); unzip it to get the file.

          Arrange panels

          Drag a panel by its handle, or use the arrows, to set the order you want. Untick a panel to hide it. The order is kept on this device.

            Walls from curves

            The selected lines become walls of this type. They stay editable as curves: move, trim or extend them and the walls follow.

              Put on sheets

              Pick a sheet set. Every sheet stays linked to the model and redraws when it changes. One plan is made for each level.

              Welcome to ItterivaThree quick choices. Each one can be changed later on its own, from the top bar or by typing WELCOME.

              1Which program do you already know?

              Pick every program you know. We open with the shortcuts, mouse and command names of the main one, and commands from the others work too.

              2Which program do you want to learn?

              Keep working your way. After each command, a small card above the command line shows how the program you're learning does the same step.

              3How much help do you want on screen?

              Layout, controls and learning are separate settings. You can change any one of them later from the top bar without touching the others.

              Not affiliated with McNeel, Autodesk, Trimble or Adobe.
